verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's docs describe drafting feature revisions, requesting review, and requiring approval before publishing. The pricing page lists "Approval workflows" as a top-tier plan feature, alongside per-environment flag control (dev/staging/production). The core of the story, gating flag changes behind approval, is documented, but only in brief first-party snippets. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that approvals can be scoped to the production environment, any independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail beyond short doc summaries. The paid-tier gating is also a caveat.
